title: Colour lineup slide-in cascade
summary: Seven side-profile desktop units in seven colours slide in from the right one after another on a near-white field; the row re-spaces as each joins and settles into an even lineup that holds. Calm, keynote-style variant reveal.
use_when: Hardware or product with several colour or model variants
A short silent loop or opener for a lineup announcement
A light, minimal keynote voice with no copy on screen
A bridge shot before a variant picker or pricing line

sfx.event: each unit slides in from the right edge

structure.shot: empty near-white field, nothing on screen
structure.motion: none; first unit's foot edge crosses the right frame edge at f10

structure.shot: side-profile desktop units (thin tilted panel on an angled stand) slide in from the right, one colour each, 7 in total
structure.camera: static frame; the whole row travels left (about 384 px/s @1920 in 1.00-2.00 s) and its spacing tightens from ~25 % W to ~14 % W as units join; unit size constant
structure.motion: unit entrances at f10, f15, f21, f27, f33, f41, f50 (stagger 5-6 fr, then 8-9 fr for the last two, ±1 fr from a 30 fps strip); each unit enters from off-screen right on easings.outExpo, the row re-spaces on springs.heavy and settles at ~f75 (overshoot not measurable, ±0.25 s)

structure.shot: the full 7-colour lineup holds, evenly spaced, centred, units span ~92 % W
structure.motion: hold, no change between 2.50 and 3.77 cells; motion.json diff 0.06 then 0.00

params.brand: any brand.json: bg for the field; accent can be one of the variant colours
params.content.variants: 3-8 variant colours, each {panel, stand} hex (stand is a pale tint of the panel)
params.content.device: silhouette of the product in side profile (default: thin tilted panel on an angled stand)
params.timing.stagger: frames between unit entrances (default 6, last two 8-9)
params.aspect: 16:9 | 1:1 | 4:5 | 9:16; vertical aspects need fewer units or a smaller unit
params.fps: composition fps (default 30); all timing scales with it

notes: Measured from a 30 fps strip (0.30-2.30 s): entrance onsets f10, f15, f21, f27, f33, f41, f50; units never change size, only the gaps shrink (motion.json reads that as -31 %/s zoom). Settled by 2.50 s, then 1.5 s still hold. device-laptop is the closest vocabulary device id; the unit is a drawn side-profile desktop with no screen content. Proposed term lineup-cascade (recipe.md). sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured (reference is silent).
